correctness.rationale: Every face has at most one arc of each of four types. All possible directed cycles have lengths 2 or 4, yielding a complete local characterization. The eight type permutations preserving two allowed pairs act simplicially. Signed augmented Lefschetz equals (-1)^number_of_selected_arc_orbits; every invariant face uses whole leaf cycles, and its at-most-four-arc bound makes twelve cycle-support templates exhaustive for all n. Exact finite differences on these templates produce the five polynomials; standalone standard-library code verified every coefficient and independently checked 9,686 arc subsets, 9,432 symmetry images, and 220 full-character evaluations. The claim only concerns alternating rational homology traces.

value.rationale: The hidden dihedral symmetry of the directed-graph multipath complex is a structural observation for an infinite natural family. Its complete five-class equivariant Lefschetz formulas are not inferable from Betti numbers or ordinary Euler characteristics, and isolate dependence on leaf cycles of lengths 1,2,4; the quarter-turn class uniquely detects four-cycles. The closed expressions apply even when separate homology groups are not classified and furnish representation-theoretic benchmarks for future graded calculations.
